title: Fraser family ties to the Barnes and Morrell musicians
summary: He explains that the Barnes and Morrell musicians' mothers were his father's Fraser sisters.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Now, maybe before you start on that, can you tell us a little bit about your family? I know, of course, you're related to the Barnes and the Morarras.
I understand, I think, Milly Barnes told us that the Fraser is the main name of the whole family originally.
It is, it is. That's right, it is.
You can tell a little bit how they're related.

Related. Well, Milly Barnes and Paul Barnes, their mother was my father's sister. And John Morrell, Simon Morrell, Lawrence Morrell, Eddie Morrell, all musicians. Their mother was my father's sister from the Fraser.
Their mother was the Fraser. And the Barnes' mother was the Fraser.
Was the Fraser. That's right. Yes, that's how they began.
